Dylan Van Assche

Dylan Van Assche is a PhD student and Semantic Web researcher who has worked at Ghent University. Early Life and Education

Dylan Van Assche is a Belgian researcher who pursued his higher education in computer science. He is currently a PhD student, focusing on Semantic Web research. Career

Van Assche has worked as a researcher at Ghent University, a Dutch-speaking university in Belgium. During his tenure at the university, he contributed to various projects related to Semantic Web and artificial intelligence. Evidence of Employment
